title: Yuan-San NDE 16118
content: Posted in Zhi Hu on 5-7-2017 I had severe insomnia for sometime, so got a prescription for sleeping pills from the hospital. Initially, I got a five-day supply and it worked quite well. Over time though, I developed a tolerance to the medicine, such that one pill did not help me to sleep. One night around 8 pm, I experienced the first time without sleep for the whole night. I felt extremely sleepy, then I closed my eyes but still could not fall asleep. I took 3 pills, instead of one so that I could have a good night sleep. After taking the pills, my chest hurt like I was being punched by someone. It was very unbearable and I had trouble breathing. No matter how I changed my body position, I still felt uncomfortable. I opened the window and tried to breathe the fresh air, thinking it might help me feel better. My chest pain went away, but I lost consciousness for the next 3 seconds and dropped down to the floor. I lay on the floor for 30 minutes without any pain. As I reflected on this experience, the weirdest moment was when I was unresponsive. I dreamt that I was in a vast emptiness where there were no trees, animals, or even grass. I stood there in confusion. Then I saw two tall people with fuzzy faces and wearing hoodie-robes who appeared before me. They asked me to follow them. I had never experienced this surreal and strange feeling before. I just knew it was all right to go with them. Still, this felt odd and very unfamiliar. I followed them as we walked a long way. Suddenly, it seemed like there was a warm light appearing up above my head that was coming down. I was told, 'Don't continue, stop going forward!' Anyway, I knew in my head that I had to leave these two people. Then, I ran like crazy towards the light. Initially, one of them tried to grab my hand but he didn't get to me. They stood there while watching me run. I kept running to the light. I felt much safer afterwards. Instantly, I woke up. I wrote down all the details to remember this special dream. I think it was an exceptional experience.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two tall people with fuzzy faces wearing hoodie-robes who asked the experiencer to follow them.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Possible medication overdose/reaction from taking three sleeping pills; brief loss of consciousness after chest pain and trouble breathing.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Vast emptiness/void; two tall hooded figures guiding; warning voice/message: "Don't continue, stop going forward!"; running toward warm light; immediate awakening.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience described as being in a void/emptiness with two figures, then a warm light above with a warning to stop, followed by running toward the light and waking instantly; no tunnel or OBE described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience is framed as a 'dream' during a brief period of unresponsiveness after taking three sleeping pills; two fuzzy-faced hooded figures attempted to lead the experiencer away until a warm light and warning prompted escape.
